content.text: /ext:medcp Pick a common antiseizure medicine and report how many epilepsy patients received it.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE lower(concept_name) = 'epilepsy'
  AND domain_id = 'Condition'
ORDER BY standard_concept DESC, vocabulary_id
LIMIT 20

FROM omop.concept

  AND domain_id = 'Condition'

SELECT TOP 20 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%levetiracetam%'
  AND domain_id = 'Drug'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN concept_class_id = 'Ingredient' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, standard_concept DESC, concept_name

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS epilepsy_patients_receiving_levetiracetam
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_cond
  ON co.condition_concept_id = ca_cond.descendant_concept_id
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de
  ON de.person_id = co.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_drug
  ON de.drug_concept_id = ca_drug.descendant_concept_id
WHERE ca_cond.ancestor_concept_id = 380378  -- Epilepsy (SNOMED)
  AND ca_drug.ancestor_concept_id = 711584  -- levetiracetam (RxNorm ingredient)
